title: Explicit ordinary and cochain closed-test mate constructions
statement: For the commutative condensed ring and scheme squares in [def-sfb-closed-test-kinjective-section-maps] and [def-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-maps], use the ordinary pullback compositor to define ordinarySquare, its specified adjunction mate ordinaryExchange, the actual testSectionArrow and unit testSectionUnit, terminalSections and globalLocalizationModel, ordinary and derived direct-image pasting squares, evaluatedExchange, chainMate, sectionChain, evaluatedChainMate and pushEvaluationChain. pastingAdjunctionCompatible records conjugacy under the specified adjunctions.
